subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

MU, NE, PX, QF, SA, TG, ?
solution: According to the English alphabets & their positional values: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] The pattern followed is: ** First alphabet is increased by 1 at odd steps & by 2 at even steps. Second alphabet is increased by the difference of 2 at odd steps & decrease by the difference of 2 at even steps.**
